caption:
Seven small things to try together this week.

There's research behind that. A UCL study of more than 3,700 couples found that people were more likely to quit smoking, get active or lose weight when their partner made the same change at the same time.

Number 1 is our favourite. A 20-minute walk after dinner, phones away, is when we actually talk about our day.

Save this for the weekend, and send it to your other half. Pick one to start together.
